$comment: Shared wire fixture for the compose-parity-locator/v1 block. Three engines read it: cli ServeIssueReportTest, which asserts ServeIssueReport.locatorBlock emits `block` byte for byte from `writer`; cli/serve-web test/reportLocator.test.ts, which asserts the browser writer behind the comparison wall's multi-row picker emits the same bytes from the same `writer` (it has to write blocks the server never saw, because which comparisons a report names is chosen by ticking rows after the page was served); and scripts/design-artifacts/parity-issues.test.mjs, which asserts parseLocator(block) yields `parse`. Neither side can move the contract without failing the other's test. Cases with no `writer` are shapes no writer emits and the producer must refuse.

cases.name: full
cases.why: Every field a delivery-branch-backed comparison can name, with override values that exercise quoting and non-ASCII.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {"fontScale":"1.5","knob.label":"Send;now=x","knob.quote":"a=\"b\"","knob.text":"日本語"}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

cases.name: no-revision
cases.why: A local `compose-preview serve` over a bundle directory has no delivery provenance, so the writer omits the line. This is the session a developer reports from.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {}
```

cases.name: empty-variant
cases.why: `ServeIssueReport.variantFor` returns "" for a preview id carrying no `__` axes. No axes is a fact about the preview, not a mangled body.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton
preview: IconButton
reference: iconbutton-figma
variant: 
overrides: {}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

cases.name: astral-override-keys
cases.why: U+FF01 sorts BELOW U+1F600 by code point and ABOVE it by UTF-16 code unit, so this block is canonical to the writer and non-canonical to a `.sort()` that compares code units.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {"！b":"1","😀a":"2"}
```

cases.name: non-canonical-overrides
cases.why: Hand-reordered override keys. No writer emits this, and it must stay refused — the canonical form is what makes two bodies for the same variant compare equal.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {"knob.label":"Send;now=x","fontScale":"1.5"}
```

cases.name: blank-identity-field
cases.why: An emptied identity field is a mangled body: the locator no longer names one component.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: 
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {}
```

cases.name: element-and-bounds
cases.why: The two fields batch 01 reserved for batch 03's selection. Nothing writes them yet; both engines must round-trip them now, because adding a key to a frozen v1 later is refused by a strict parser and silently dropped by a permissive one. The tag is a JSON string: a testTag is arbitrary text, and a line-oriented block cannot carry a newline, a fence delimiter or edge whitespace unquoted.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1
repository: yschimke/m3-catalog
system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {}
element: "glyph"
bounds: {"height":24,"space":"render-pixels","width":24,"x":18,"y":18}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

cases.name: bounds-in-another-space
cases.why: D1 settles that the tag index publishes render-pixel bounds and the canonical-plane transform belongs to the comparison. A rectangle in the display plane is the failure that makes an element which never moved report as moved, so v1 refuses any other space rather than storing the guess.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1

system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma
variant: ideal/default/light
overrides: {}
element: "glyph"
bounds: {"height":24,"space":"display-pixels","width":24,"x":18,"y":18}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

cases.name: bounds-not-canonical
cases.why: Same rule the overrides carry: the block is canonical bytes, so two records are comparable without parsing. Key order here is insertion order, not code-point order.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1

component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma

overrides: {}
element: "glyph"
bounds: {"x":18,"y":18,"width":24,"height":24,"space":"render-pixels"}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

cases.name: element-unquoted
cases.why: A bare tag is what makes `row\nrevision: injected` parse as two fields — an element silently truncated and a revision nobody wrote. v1 takes a JSON string so the value cannot become syntax.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1

system: m3-catalog
component: IconButton/Tonal
preview: iconbutton-tonal__ideal__default__light
reference: iconbutton-tonal-figma

overrides: {}
element: glyph
bounds: {"height":24,"space":"render-pixels","width":24,"x":18,"y":18}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

parse.error: element must be a JSON string

cases.name: element-with-a-newline
cases.why: The injection this encoding exists to stop, written out: the tag carries a line break and its escape keeps it one field instead of opening `revision:`.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1

overrides: {}
element: "row\nrevision: injected"
```

cases.name: bounds-above-the-render-root
cases.why: A uniquely tagged node can extend above or left of the render root, and both tag-index producers emit signed coordinates for it. A validator refusing a negative origin would mean batch 03 could not copy the bounds it was handed; clipping belongs to the comparison's plane transform.
cases.block:
```compose-parity-locator/v1

bounds: {"height":24,"space":"render-pixels","width":24,"x":-4,"y":-2}
revision: yschimke/m3-catalog@design-artifacts/m3-catalog
```

bodies.$comment: Whole issue bodies rather than single blocks: these exercise parseLocators, and the Kotlin side asserts its writer emits the same bytes for each block in order.
bodies.name: umbrella-two-components
bodies.why: One issue legitimately spans several components — m3-catalog#42's Elevated shadow level covers three. One block can name one component, so the body carries one block each and the index emits one row per block.
bodies.body:

```compose-parity-locator/v1
system: m3-catalog
component: Button/Elevated
preview: button-elevated__ideal__default__light
reference: button-elevated__ideal__default__light
variant: ideal/default/light
```
```compose-parity-locator/v1
overrides: {}
```

bodies.name: umbrella-repeats-a-component
bodies.why: Two rows with one identity collapse against each other in the reader, so a body that names the same component twice is refused rather than silently halved.
